contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes

tire_step_size = step_size

render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

vehicle.SetStallTorque(0.3)
vehicle.SetTireRollingResistance(0.06)

vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('dart')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh

# Initialize the PyChrono environment
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('./data/')

# Create the simulation system
mysystem = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Create the vehicle
veh_mdl = veh.ArticulatedRigidMultibodyDifferential()
veh_mdl.SetContactMethod(chrono.ContactMethod_NSC)
veh_mdl.SetChassisVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
veh_mdl.SetChassisCollisionModel(chrono.ChCollisionModelType_NONE)
veh_mdl.SetSuspensionVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
veh_mdl.SetSteeringVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
veh_mdl.SetWheelVisualization(chrono.ChVisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)

# Set vehicle location and orientation
veh_mdl.SetChassisFixed(False)
veh_mdl.SetInitial_XYZ(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5))
veh_mdl.SetInitial_AngZ(chrono.ChAngleD(0))

# Add vehicle to the simulation system
mysystem.Add(veh_mdl)

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(mysystem, 10, 10, 1, 1000, True, True)
terrain.SetBodyFixed(True)
terrain.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -1))
terrain.SetMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())

# Add terrain to the simulation system
mysystem.Add(terrain)

# Add a custom texture to the terrain
texture = chrono.ChTexture()
texture.SetTextureFilename('./data/textures/concrete.jpg')
terrain.AddAsset(texture)

# Create an interactive driver system
driver = veh.ArticulatedRigidMultibodyDifferentialDriver(veh_mdl)
driver.SetSteeringMode(chrono.SteeringMode_LOCKEDDIFF)
driver.SetThrottleMode(chrono.ThrottleMode_LOCKEDRATIO)
driver.SetBrakingMode(chrono.BrakingMode_LOCKEDBRAKES)

# Add driver to the simulation system
mysystem.Add(driver)

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
application = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
application.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 10), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
application.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 10, 0), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))

# Add the vehicle and terrain to the visualization
application.Add(veh_mdl)
application.Add(terrain)

# Set up the simulation loop
steptime = 0.02
tend = 10

while application.GetDevice().run():
    mysystem.DoStepDynamics(steptime)
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()
    application.DoStep()
    chrono.ChUtils::Sleep(steptime)
    if mysystem.GetChTime() > tend:
        break

# Delete the visualization application
del application
```
